title: BLUE 9 x 12 IS NOT BLUE
text:
BLUE 9 x 12 IS NOT BLUE. With a rug that big the design ended up being mostly white, yellow and RED FUZZY threads.
But #1 > We had to return immed due to mold odor. Only real blue is center design - not much at all. Mostly a white and yellow rug stretched to 9' x 12'.
